content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Gumroad promises simplicity: upload your product, set a price, and sell. But this convenience comes with hidden costs. You’re renting infrastructure, not owning it. Stripe and PayPal offer payment processing but exclude entire countries, leaving creators in Nigeria stranded. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) flips this model. It’s not a platform—it’s a toolkit. You deploy your own stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. The result? A fully operational store where you control every layer. No subscriptions. No platform fees. Lifetime access. This isn’t a workaround; it’s a structural alternative designed for creators who need sovereignty, not simplicity.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad, Stripe, and PayPal exclude countries based on geopolitical risk, not technical limitations. For Nigerian creators, this means no access to core features like payouts or even account creation. COREMERCH’s architecture bypasses this entirely. By leveraging crypto payments via NOWPayments, you accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. Hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages ensures global accessibility. This isn’t a patch—it’s a redesign of commerce infrastructure that treats exclusion as a solvable engineering problem, not an inevitable cost of doing business.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad charges 10% per transaction, plus payment processor fees. Stripe and PayPal add 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, if they’re even available. COREMERCH’s model cuts out the middlemen. With NOWPayments, you pay 0.5% per transaction—no monthly fees, no hidden costs. Payments confirm on-chain instantly, triggering automatic product delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Compare this to Gumroad’s delayed payouts and platform lock-in. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a one-time investment. After deployment, you own the infrastructure. No recurring fees. No revenue share. Just direct payments to your wallet. This is what sovereignty looks like in commerce.
COREMERCH stacks are pressure-tested against currency collapse and payment rejection.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

On Gumroad, your store, customer data, and payment flow belong to Gumroad. If they shut down or change terms, you’re stranded. COREMERCH’s stacks give you full ownership. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets—databases you control. File delivery is automated via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Even the payment webhook from NOWPayments is yours to configure. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes blueprints and templates for all this. Deploy once, and the system runs itself. No platform dependence. No data lock-in. Just infrastructure you own and control.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re a Nigerian creator selling digital products and need immediate sovereignty, COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) is the clear choice. It’s not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent shift to infrastructure you own. Gumroad is fine if you’re in a supported country and value simplicity over control. But if Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, Gumroad is useless. COREMERCH’s stacks are built for creators who can’t afford to wait for platforms to change their policies. Deploy in 48 hours. Accept crypto payments globally. Automate delivery. Own your stack. This is commerce infrastructure designed for the reality you’re in, not the one Silicon Valley assumes you’re in.
